reason: aarch64 virt: the differences from QEMU that the operator approved in Q2 of the phase 3d design

differences.reason: vmlab-hv presents no PMU. QEMU's -cpu max has PMUv3 on PPI 7 (GSIV 23). QEMU itself writes 0 here for -cpu cortex-a53,pmu=off (captures a53-nopmu-*).

no_difference.reason: The CPU that vmlab-hv presents (Armv8.0-A with CRC32, AES, SHA1 and SHA2) is not QEMU's -cpu max. No fw_cfg file depends on the CPU model: QEMU's files for -cpu max and -cpu cortex-a53 are the same (captures smp2-2g and a53-smp2-2g). The difference shows in the ID registers, which a capture from inside a guest compares.
